title: Gentle-swap coordinator: Terraform-driven VPC data-plane rollout with safety gates
creator: Ana Morales
description: Goal: implement a 'gentle-swap coordinator' Terraform/IaC pattern that performs data-plane/runtime upgrades inside customer VPCs with zero-downtime intent and a deterministic rollback path. This ticket covers the IaC modules, the coordinator service orchestration, health-gating rules tied to telemetry, and the rollback playbook. We will avoid any host-level disruptive operations by changing routing and sidecar attachments at the network edge and coordinating a staged in-place swap for the runtime instances. The coordinator uses staged terraform apply plans per tenant slice, updates route tables/edge listeners, and only flips traffic when health gates pass for a configurable stability window. Key constraints: preserve KV cache affinity where possible, keep live sessions (session tokens) pinned during the handoff, and limit priming noise to a small shadow percentage to avoid destabilizing upstream services.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform modules produce a repeatable plan to perform a per-slice runtime swap without modifying persistent storage or taking nodes offline
Automatic gating: rollout proceeds only when P50 latency change < 15ms, P95 < 75ms, error-rate delta < 0.5% and KV hit-rate delta < 2% over a 10-minute sliding window
Canary traffic mirror and 1% live shadow traffic priming run successfully for at least 15 minutes with no customer-visible errors
Rollback playbook executes via a single terraform apply that rebinds routes and revokes new sidecar attachments; full rollback completes within target 8 minutes in synthetic test
Runbook and console dashboards updated with a per-tenant rollout view, health gates, and rollback button
steps: Design IaC: add 'gentle_swap' module that handles staged terraform plan/apply and emits preflight checks
Implement coordinator service to take a list of tenant slices and run plan/apply with health gating and slotted windows
Add sidecar health-adapter that exposes KV cache metrics and session-presence probes
Wire telemetry: export P50/P95, errors, KV hit-rate, and request-path histograms to console and a dedicated rollout dashboard
Create synthetic traffic harness and smoke-tests for rollback timing and fidelity
Add terraform hooks to create snapshot of route state and a reversible plan for fast rollback
checklist: IaC module: initial implementation and docs
Coordinator: feature flag + canary run in staging
Sidecar probe: merged and deployed to staging
Telemetry dashboards: rollout-dashboard and per-tenant slice view
Synthetic traffic job: runbooked and automated
Runbook: incident playbook including manual abort and emergency rollback steps
Security review: KMS access patterns and least-privilege service account verified
notes: Tradeoffs considered: 1) Traffic shadowing vs full canary — we pick small live shadowing (1%) plus mirrored traffic to validate behavior without exposing customers. 2) KV preservation — full migration of hot KV is expensive; current approach is affinity-first (try to keep existing node handling session tokens) with background reconciliation. 3) Terraform-driven routing flips simplify auditability but require careful state handling; we keep reversible plans and preflight snapshots. Early perf targets observed in staging: P95 variance under 20ms during shadowing when prefetch disabled. We will iterate on adaptive priming thresholds based on slice size.
blockers: Terraform state locking conflicts on large tenant batches observed in staging
Need final sign-off from security on service-account KMS permissions
Synthetic traffic harness needs additional payload variants for long-tail prompts
decision_record: Adopted an orchestrated route-flip model controlled by a coordinator that performs staggered terraform applies per-tenant-slice. Health gates are enforced by telemetry thresholds and a stability window. Rollback is implemented as a deterministic reverse apply using stored route snapshots and a precomputed rollback plan. This minimizes blast radius compared to replacing nodes or performing in-place image rollouts.
next_steps: Finish PR reviews for infra and coordinator, run a full dry-run against staging with 5 representative tenant slices, schedule an on-call walkthrough of the runbook, and book the security sign-off meeting for 2026-03-18. After staging success, plan a pilot with two low-risk enterprise tenants the week of 2026-03-22.
